hook.text: What if you could subscribe to a single journalist for $5/month instead of an entire newspaper?

buildup.text: Substack, Patreon, and Buy Me a Coffee enable micro-subscriptions: tiny payments to individual creators.

discovery.text: Micro-subscriptions unbundle institutions. Why subscribe to a gym when you can subscribe to one trainer?

twist.text: Micro-subscriptions can overwhelm consumers. Managing 20 creator subscriptions is more work than one Netflix.

climax.text: The trend is toward smaller, more personalized subscriptions—and the platforms that aggregate them.

punchline.text: One creator, $5/month. Big institutions get unbundled into people.
